shipped_dist: Approved consumer and merchant design extended with connected shop discovery, repeat payments, public guest checkout, payment-link sharing and permissioned business planning.

validation.android_layout_scope: Synthetic data rendered through the native showTask shell using Robolectric native graphics. Physical keyboard and device behaviour remain unverified.
validation.web_test_evidence: Full npm test passed on the resumed release source: 1,618 tests, zero failures, cancellations or skips, including service shutdown and recovery on retained payment forms.
validation.android_test_evidence: Saved 2.11.0 verification: 63 pure-Java suites and 172 Robolectric framework cases, zero framework failures, errors or skips. Independently verified APK package, signing, checksum and alignment during release continuation.
browser_verified: Synthetic registered Lumo row tap opened the selected person’s named amount screen directly in the dark theme.
Synthetic MoMo phone-only lookup showed sample network/name confirmation, then GH₵25 principal plus GH₵0.50 fee review, synthetic PIN approval, virtual debit and successful receipt.
Synthetic bank/account lookup showed sample name and bank confirmation, then GH₵40 principal plus GH₵1.00 fee review, synthetic PIN approval, virtual debit and successful receipt.
After both synthetic transfers, the fixture available balance decreased from GH₵1,000.00 to GH₵933.50.
Controls remained reachable in the 440px-high light-theme fixture. Dark-theme Lumo and MoMo screens were also inspected.
limitations: The native APK has not been installed on a physical handset or executed on ART in this release verification.
Sample MoMo routing and account names demonstrate the lookup journey. No live network or account-name provider is connected.
validation.browser_verification_scope: The existing consumer payment components were rendered with synthetic account, service and PIN fixtures. These checks did not write production account records or move real money.
